	<item>
		<title>DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions</title>
		<link>https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/22/deepseek-reportedly-raises-15b-days-after-us-restrictions/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[Kate Park]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:11:13 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[AI]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Fundraising]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[artificial intellignce]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[deepseek]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Funding]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[In Brief]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://techcrunch.com/?p=3180589</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.]]></description>
		
		
		
			</item><item>
		<title>Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation</title>
		<link>https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/17/wispr-raises-280m-at-2b-valuation-as-it-looks-beyond-dictation/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[Ivan Mehta]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:10:05 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Fundraising]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[AI]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Funding]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Wispr]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://techcrunch.com/?p=3153341</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[The funds will allow Wispr to increase its footprint as it ventures into new areas, such as meetings, with its newly released note-taker tool.]]></description>
		
		
		
			</item><item>
		<title>Airbnb-backed WeRoad raises $58M to take its group travel platform to the US</title>
		<link>https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/27/airbnb-backed-weroad-raises-58m-to-take-its-group-travel-platform-to-the-us/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[Lauren Forristal]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Wed, 27 May 2026 08:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Social]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Apps]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Startups]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Airbnb]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Funding]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Series C funding]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://techcrunch.com/?p=3126231</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[WeRoad trips are primarily designed for younger travelers and grouped around shared interests and travel styles. Customers can book trips through the platform based on themes such as beach vacations or skiing. ]]></description>
